title: OneNote for Android: multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap, Capture licence requirements and documented control routes support its actionable claims. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge the conflicting Microsoft storage descriptions, and narrow the checklist's policy test to the control actually shown in its table.

claims.quote: Multimodal capture is now available in OneNote Copilot Notebooks for Android, matching the existing capability on iPhone and iPad.

claims.quote: ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to test the Cloud Policy settings, including the separate mobile Capture policy, although the controls table contains only the general Pages and Notebooks setting.

Test whether the Cloud Policy settings stop capture on Android before relying on them.
The article gives no admin path or API for it and no Android-specific enforcement description, so it is not a table row here.
claims.fix: Replace the After rollout policy-test bullet with: 'Test whether the Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks Cloud Policy setting stops capture on Android before relying on it.'
